---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a defect or non-conformance in an existing skill
title: '[BUG]: '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Skill Name:**
e.g. `ai-website-polish`

**Describe the Bug:**
A clear and concise description of what failed or where the skill instructions produced degraded output.

**Agent Environment:**
- Agent Tool / Harness: [e.g. Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex]
- LLM Model: [e.g. Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o]

**Observed Agent Behavior:**
What did the agent actually generate?

**Expected Invariant:**
What should the skill have constrained the model to do instead?
